name: Deep Research Guard
description: Lightweight OpenClaw runtime support for deep-research checkpoints, recovery, and stop reminders.

guardMode.description: lite only reminds/checkpoints and avoids most tool blocking; strict enables legacy stage/tool gates.

subagentMaxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries for a failed sub-agent task before marking it as failed and continuing.

retryBaseDelayMs.description: Base delay in ms before retrying a failed sub-agent task. Exponential backoff is applied.

retryMaxDelayMs.description: Maximum delay in ms for retry backoff.
